sections.heading: Adult activity targets
sections.content: Adults generally benefit from regular movement across the week. A practical target is at least 150 to 300 minutes of moderate-intensity aerobic activity weekly, or 75 to 150 minutes of vigorous-intensity activity, with muscle-strengthening activities on two or more days when possible.

sections.heading: Reduce sedentary time
sections.content: Some activity is better than none. People who are inactive can start with short, manageable sessions such as walking, light cycling, or household movement, then gradually increase duration and intensity.

sections.heading: Safety note
sections.content: People with concerning symptoms, new chest pain, fainting, severe breathlessness, or major medical conditions should seek medical advice before substantially increasing exercise intensity.
